title: One image to full 3D scene: automated segmentation, mesh gen, scene reconstruction, PBR textures from a prompt
author: Pradyumgg

comments.author: RemarkableGuidance44
comments.body: All done locally? I think most people dont care unless its local.

replies.author: Pradyumgg
replies.body: its not run locally right now, an api is being called from the cloud. but we are soon implementing a bring your own api feature, where you can have your own api give the output instead of using ours.

replies.author: RemarkableGuidance44
replies.body:
So its an application you are selling... at least tag under Commercial Self Promo. 

Also why would I buy, when I can copy?

replies.author: Pradyumgg
replies.body:
I am not promoting it, i have nowhere mentioned the product name or asking people to buy/try it. I just wanted feedback/ a discussion on how the output is.

and regarding copying it. this is not something that can be so easily copied. we have implemented an agent inside our software which is much more powerful than mcp and is something which has an expertise in 3d work giving you much better outputs. We have been building this for over a year. I don't think it can be "copied" so easily.
